button.name: sky_goto_real_place
button.label: Go to Real place
button.tool_tip: Show the Real place tab, where the real sky is switched on or off.

button.name: sky_open_wolf_env
button.label: Open Wolf Environment...
button.tool_tip: World > Wolf World > Wolf Environment, where the region's Wolf Environment is set up or switched off.

combo_box.name: sky_preset
combo_box.tool_tip: The skies and day cycles that come with the viewer. Type the first letters of a name to jump to it.

panel.text: Or use one from your inventory

button.name: sky_inventory
button.label: Use Inventory Sky...
button.tool_tip: Pick a sky, water or day cycle from your inventory (the Library's Environments folder too).

panel.text: or drag one from your inventory onto this page.

A day cycle changes through the day; a fixed sky stays the same all day. Parcels with their own environment keep theirs. With the Wolf sky on (the WE button), the Wolf sky takes its sun, moon, clouds and haze from this sky; with it off, this sky is shown as it is.

button.name: sky_apply
button.label: Apply
button.tool_tip: Show the chosen sky to everyone in the region.

button.name: sky_revert
button.label: Revert
button.tool_tip: Forget the choice; the region's sky stays as it is.

button.name: sky_default
button.label: Default sky...
button.tool_tip: Put the region back on the default sky (you are asked first).
